method.no_feedback: Earliest saved round-0 record for each target; no rerun.
method.with_feedback: Final saved record from the latest evaluation occurrence for each target; no spec-generation rerun.

no_spec_reason_descriptions.runtime_or_hidden_state: Result depends on OS/runtime/process state not exposed by a stable pure view.
no_spec_reason_descriptions.needs_new_vstd_abstraction: Required semantic vocabulary or owner/module model is absent from vstd.
no_spec_reason_descriptions.trait_contract_integration: Requires editing or composing an external trait specification.
no_spec_reason_descriptions.concurrency_or_hidden_state: Atomic/concurrent state is not represented by an ordinary deterministic view.
no_spec_reason_descriptions.unsafe_or_representation_sensitive: Raw pointer, provenance, unsafe, or representation-sensitive behavior.
no_spec_reason_descriptions.determinism_checker_unsupported: Current checker cannot encode the exact output or mutable post-state.
no_spec_reason_descriptions.iterator_or_adapter_result: Iterator/guard/adapter result needs a prophetic or state-transition model.
no_spec_reason_descriptions.formatting_effect: Formatting state and emitted effects are not modeled.
no_spec_reason_descriptions.toolchain_unavailable: API is unavailable in the Verus Rust 1.96 toolchain.
no_spec_reason_descriptions.representation_or_allocator: Allocator or private representation state is absent from the public view.
no_spec_reason_descriptions.higher_order_contract: Closure/callback semantics require call-ensures or a higher-order model.
no_spec_reason_descriptions.ownership_or_uninitialized_model: Linear ownership, initialization, or MaybeUninit state is not modeled.
no_spec_reason_descriptions.complex_result_or_pattern_model: Result discriminant/pattern semantics need an additional model.
no_spec_reason_descriptions.no_modeled_observable_output: No return value or mutable output is represented by the checker.
no_spec_reason_descriptions.needs_borrowed_key_or_ordering_model: Borrow<Q> functionality or cross-type ordering is missing.
no_spec_reason_descriptions.needs_pointer_identity_or_provenance_mod: Semantic views erase location, identity, address, or provenance.
no_spec_reason_descriptions.needs_functional_trait_semantics: Clone/Default is only relational and does not uniquely determine output.
